data.name: Virginia Hug Emote
data.shortDescription: Restores the cut Virginia hug interaction with the player.
data.description:
This mod restores a cut Virginia Hug interaction with the player. By default you also gain a stamina recovery buff for 5 minutes when you do this and it grants you extra virginia sentiment. Virginia will also giggle shortly after being hugged with one of 20 voicelines.

### How to hug Virginia

Stand next to Virginia and press Shift+O. If you want to stop the hug press Shift+U. This will also cancel the stamina buff.

### You can customize the following in this mod:

1. Whether or not the player also triggers an animation during the hug.  For some users they may prefer this off to avoid clipping.
2. How loud her giggle voice after hugs is.
3. Whether or not there is a stamina buff.
4. How much stamina recovery you get from it if any. 
5. How long the stamina buff lasts(5 minutes by default).

### Other things to note:

1. Endnight cut this interaction from the game because they were worried it would cause problems since it locks the player in place. This mod solves this by allowing you to interrupt it at any time.

2. This is not a perfect restoration. I could not find a corresponding hug animation on the player so I had to improvise by using one of the other player animations. And to ensure Virginia is running smoothly after the hug ends, I had to reinitialize her AI which results in a temporary stutter. 

3. The voice lines found in this mod are replaceable wav files. In case you want to use something else. None of the clips were generated with AI.

### Virginia will not hug you if:

1. She is scared 
2. Nearly dead or dead.
3. In Combat
4. Sleeping
5. On Fire

### Multiplayer:

Now tested. Only works for the host in peer to peer games right now. However when the host hugs Virginia it syncs to other players.

I plan to allow the host to determine if they want to allow clients to hug.
